protocol_vocabulary.chat: plain chat completion, no output grammar
protocol_vocabulary.chat_bounded_reasoning_t2: chat with bounded reasoning budget (T2 family), reasoning-channel budget enforced and verified
protocol_vocabulary.thinking_disabled_chat: chat with native thinking channel verified disabled
protocol_vocabulary.native_function_calling: model-native tool-call protocol where the runtime supports it
protocol_vocabulary.completion_negative_transfer: raw completion endpoint used only as a negative-transfer comparator on bounded panels

C01.cognitive_definition: Map a user turn to exactly one intent class from a closed, enumerated set given only the utterance and the class catalog.
C01.required_observable_behavior: Emit a single class label from the offered catalog that matches the independently derived intent of the utterance.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: No tool execution, no state, no argument construction; pure closed-set classification.

C01.public_task_information: Utterance (CN or EN), intent catalog with one-line descriptions, instruction to choose exactly one label.

output_contract.representation: single catalog label (bare or single-field JSON)
constraints: label must be a catalog member
no free text outside the label field

C01.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic label assignment authored at task-construction time and cross-checked by the independent reference oracle from the utterance's contractual slot values, never from the model output.
correct_witnesses: utterance about refund policy -> catalog label billing.refund
utterance asking to reschedule -> catalog label schedule.change
incorrect_witnesses: billing.refund emitted for a rescheduling utterance
valid_alternatives: Exact synonym labels only where the catalog itself declares alias equivalence.
boundary_cases: utterance matching two catalog descriptions where only one is contractually correct
out-of-catalog utterance with an abstention option present
bilingual utterance mixing CN and EN intent words

C02.cognitive_definition: Extract the user's actionable goal as a typed predicate with status and deadline fields from one or more turns.
C02.required_observable_behavior: Produce a typed goal record (action, object, completion criterion, deadline when stated) consistent with the utterance.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Goal recognition only; no plan, no tool choice, no execution.

C02.public_task_information: User turns, goal-record schema, instruction to fill all fields or mark unknown.

output_contract.representation: JSON record: action, object, completion_criterion, deadline, unknown_flags
constraints: deadline normalized to ISO-8601 when derivable
unknown allowed only via explicit flags

C02.independent_ground_truth: Goal record constructed at task-design time; reference oracle re-derives it from annotated utterance spans without seeing model output.
correct_witnesses: 'submit the quarterly report by Friday' -> action=submit, object=quarterly_report, deadline=<Friday ISO>
vague wish -> action recorded with unknown_flags set rather than invented
incorrect_witnesses: completion criterion copied from a distractor turn
valid_alternatives: Equivalent normalized object names accepted when the alias table maps them; deadline in an unambiguous alternative ISO form.
boundary_cases: goal implied but never stated verbatim
two goals in one turn, instruction asks for the primary one
stated deadline conflicting with a stated constraint

C03.cognitive_definition: Comprehend one instruction exactly: its action, scope and explicit constraints, without adding or dropping requirements.
C03.required_observable_behavior: Restate or execute the single instruction with all explicit constraints honored and none invented.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Execution is deterministic downstream; only comprehension of one instruction is scored.

C03.public_task_information: One instruction with explicit constraints, the output format it demands.

output_contract.representation: format demanded by the instruction (short answer, filled record, or restate)

C03.independent_ground_truth: Constraint checklist authored per case; oracle verifies each checklist item against the output deterministically.
correct_witnesses: 'list only in-stock items, uppercase' -> in-stock items, uppercase, nothing else
restate including the stated limit 'at most three'
incorrect_witnesses: four items returned against 'at most three'
valid_alternatives: Item order unspecified unless the instruction fixes it.
boundary_cases: constraint that contradicts the data (must honor instruction over plausibility)
near-synonym constraint wording
instruction with an exclusion clause

C04.cognitive_definition: Hold several simultaneous constraints (inclusion, exclusion, ordering, numeric bounds) and satisfy all of them at once.
C04.required_observable_behavior: Produce output satisfying every stated constraint simultaneously; partial satisfaction scores as failure.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Working-memory-style constraint satisfaction; no planning or tool choice involved.

C04.public_task_information: Instruction with 2–6 typed constraints over provided data, output format.

output_contract.representation: list or record per the demanded format
constraints: all constraints checked atomically by the oracle

C04.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic filter/sort program over the case data encodes the constraints; expected output computed by executing it.
correct_witnesses: price<100 AND in-stock AND sort by rating -> exactly that set in that order
exclude vendor X, include backorder items
incorrect_witnesses: one constraint violated while others hold
constraints applied disjunctively instead of conjunctively
valid_alternatives: Ties in unspecified sort keys may appear in any order.
boundary_cases: empty satisfying set (correct answer is empty, not a best-effort list)
conflicting constraints where the instruction gives precedence
constraint referring to a computed field

C05.cognitive_definition: Decide a well-defined yes/no question against provided facts, with correct polarity.
C05.required_observable_behavior: Emit TRUE or FALSE (or the case's explicit abstain marker) matching the oracle's deterministic judgment.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Single-bit judgment; confidence and justification are out of scope here (C32).

C05.public_task_information: Facts or rules plus a yes/no question; allowed outputs.

output_contract.representation: single boolean token or boolean JSON field
constraints: exactly one of the allowed outputs

C05.independent_ground_truth: Boolean computed by a deterministic predicate over the case facts.
correct_witnesses: rule 'refund within 30 days', purchase 12 days ago -> TRUE
purchase 45 days ago -> FALSE
incorrect_witnesses: 'probably true' instead of an allowed output
valid_alternatives: Case-declared synonyms of TRUE/FALSE only.
boundary_cases: exactly-at-threshold values (boundary semantics preregistered per case)
question with a double negative
facts sufficient but adversarially phrased

C06.cognitive_definition: Choose the correct option from a small enumerated set under stated criteria, distinguishing near-miss distractors.
C06.required_observable_behavior: Emit exactly one option identifier that the criteria select.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Selection among given options; no option generation (contrast C07).

C06.public_task_information: Criteria, enumerated options with attributes, instruction to choose one.

constraints: id must exist in the option set

C06.independent_ground_truth: Criteria encoded as a deterministic argmax/filter over option attributes.
correct_witnesses: cheapest option meeting minimum rating selected
option satisfying all hard constraints chosen over cheaper non-satisfying one
incorrect_witnesses: cheapest overall ignoring the hard constraint
valid_alternatives: When the deterministic comparator declares a tie, any tied option id is accepted (tie declared in case metadata).
boundary_cases: attribute ties
option satisfying criteria only after unit conversion
criteria referring to an absent attribute (must not be chosen)

C07.cognitive_definition: Given a situation and an action catalog described in natural language, select the action the situation warrants.
C07.required_observable_behavior: Name one catalog action whose applicability conditions the situation satisfies.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Action identity is supplied; this is not autonomous tool discovery. Must never be reported as autonomous tool-selection capability.

C07.public_task_information: Situation description, action catalog (names + applicability descriptions), instruction.
C07.independent_ground_truth: Applicability rules authored per action; oracle evaluates them against the situation facts.
correct_witnesses: customer reports lost access -> action verify_identity, not reset_password
confirmed data-entry error -> action correct_record
incorrect_witnesses: action chosen because it is most frequent, contradicting the situation
paraphrased action name not in catalog
valid_alternatives: Catalog-declared action aliases only.
boundary_cases: situation satisfying two actions where rules give precedence
situation matching no action (abstain option present)
action whose applicability depends on an unstated default

C08.cognitive_definition: Select which tool from a tool inventory (2–64 candidates) serves a stated objective, judged on name and description evidence only.
C08.required_observable_behavior: Emit one registered tool identifier that serves the objective; distractor tools must be rejected.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Tool inventory is supplied with the task; this is selection-with-candidates, not autonomous discovery. Argument construction is C12+ and never merged into this score.

C08.public_task_information: Objective, candidate tool list (id, name, description), instruction to select one.

output_contract.representation: tool id from the candidate list
constraints: id must be a listed candidate

C08.independent_ground_truth: Constructed cases carry exactly one serving tool by design; oracle verifies the selected id is that tool (retrieval difficulty controlled by distractor design).
correct_witnesses: objective 'send invoice by email' -> email_sender tool, not email_preview
objective 'archive record' -> archive_record, not delete_record
incorrect_witnesses: tool absent from the candidate list emitted
valid_alternatives: Case-declared functional equivalents when two candidates genuinely serve the objective (declared in case metadata).
boundary_cases: 64-candidate inventory with graded name/description similarity
serving tool present but description sparse
objective requiring a tool chain (single best entry point declared)
failure_taxonomy: retrieval failure (tool not found in context)

C09.cognitive_definition: Produce a well-formed JSON object of a flat, declared schema with correct types and no extra structure.
C09.required_observable_behavior: Output parses as JSON and validates against the declared flat schema.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Structural validity only; semantic field correctness belongs to the task family that uses the record.

C09.public_task_information: Flat schema (field names, types), instruction, task payload.
C09.independent_ground_truth: Schema validation is the ground truth (deterministic validator distinct from the production parser: independent interpreter path).
correct_witnesses: {"name": "a", "count": 2} against schema name:string,count:integer
empty-string and zero values emitted correctly rather than omitted
incorrect_witnesses: trailing comma / unquoted key / truncated JSON
valid_alternatives: Whitespace/key-order differences are structurally irrelevant (canonicalized before comparison).
boundary_cases: unicode values CN/EN
numeric edge values (0, negative, large)
schema with optional field omitted

C10.cognitive_definition: Produce well-formed JSON conforming to a nested schema (objects/arrays to depth 2–4) with correct cardinalities.
C10.required_observable_behavior: Output validates against the nested schema including array lengths, nesting shape and leaf types.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Structural; semantic correctness of leaf values scored separately by the owning family.

C10.public_task_information: Nested JSON schema, instruction, payload requiring repeated groups.
C10.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic recursive schema validation (independent interpreter), with cardinality checks against the payload.
correct_witnesses: order with 2 line-items each having sku/qty/price nested correctly
depth-3 address nesting with repeated entries
incorrect_witnesses: array collapsed to single value when schema requires 2+
valid_alternatives: Key order and array order where schema declares order-irrelevant.
boundary_cases: empty array required by payload
mixed-type leaves (nullable)
depth-4 boundary against stated max depth

C11.cognitive_definition: Express an action sequence in a compact domain-specific language with exact syntax and token vocabulary.
C11.required_observable_behavior: Output tokenizes and parses under the DSL grammar and uses only declared tokens.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: N02R/N02RR measured zero DSL success across models; retained unchanged as a negative-result boundary, not redefined to be easier.

C11.public_task_information: DSL grammar summary, token vocabulary, instruction, payload.
C11.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic DSL parser/validator (reference implementation independent of the production interpreter).
correct_witnesses: MOVE a b; PICK c -> parses under grammar
single action with literal argument in range
valid_alternatives: Grammar-declared whitespace freedom only.
boundary_cases: empty program where payload has no actions
argument values at range boundaries
two-statement program against mostly-single-statement training-free expectations

C12.cognitive_definition: Fill declared typed slots (string, number, date, enum) from source text with exact values and normalizations.
C12.required_observable_behavior: Emit the slot record whose values equal the canonical normalized source values.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Where a case supplies the tool, argument construction is given; scored as slot filling for the given schema, never as autonomous tool selection.

C12.public_task_information: Source text, slot schema with types and normalization rules, instruction.

constraints: all declared slots present or explicitly null

C12.independent_ground_truth: Span annotations + normalization program compute expected values deterministically.
correct_witnesses: 'next Tuesday 3pm' -> date/time normalized per rules
amount 'two thousand five hundred yen' -> 2500 JPY
incorrect_witnesses: raw un-normalized string where a normalized form is required
slot filled from a distractor entity
valid_alternatives: Normalization-rule-declared equivalent forms (e.g. zero-padded or not when rule says either).
boundary_cases: two same-type entities, only one contractually relevant
value requiring unit inference from context
slot genuinely absent (null required, not guessed)

C13.cognitive_definition: Resolve mentions (pronouns, partial names, aliases) to the correct entity among candidates, using discourse and attribute evidence.
C13.required_observable_behavior: Map each target mention to the canonical entity id from the candidate set.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Reference resolution only; no state updates or actions follow in this primitive.

C13.public_task_information: Passage with mentions, entity candidate list with attributes, instruction to output mention->id pairs.
C13.independent_ground_truth: Mention annotations authored at design time; oracle resolves via deterministic attribute/discourse rules (recency + agreement features).
correct_witnesses: 'it' after tool A's result -> entity toolA.result
two contacts same surname -> correct one by role attribute
incorrect_witnesses: most-recent-entity heuristic when contract says attribute-match wins
collision: both same-surname contacts accepted for one mention
valid_alternatives: Cases declaring genuine ambiguity may accept the declared ambiguous set (metadata declares it; otherwise unique).
boundary_cases: alias defined only in an appendix note
mention split across sentences
candidate list containing a never-mentioned decoy

C14.cognitive_definition: Extract numeric values exactly as stated, including decimals, negatives, ranges and written numbers, without arithmetic drift.
C14.required_observable_behavior: Emit the exact numeric literal (typed) matching the source span.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Extraction fidelity; arithmetic manipulation belongs to the consuming family, not this score.

C14.public_task_information: Source text, requested numeric fields, typing rules.

constraints: range endpoints attributed to the correct field

C14.independent_ground_truth: Annotated spans converted by deterministic formatter; oracle compares parsed values exactly.
correct_witnesses: '不下于三个' -> lower bound 3 recorded in the bound field
valid_alternatives: Trailing zero forms (1200.50 == 1200.5).
boundary_cases: written-number forms in CN and EN
adjacent distractor numbers
negative and currency-adjacent values

C15.cognitive_definition: Interpret units and currencies, convert when a target unit is requested, and preserve magnitude through conversion.
C15.required_observable_behavior: Emit the value in the requested unit/currency with correct conversion factor application.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Conversion uses only rates/factors supplied in the case; no external rates.

C15.public_task_information: Value with source unit/currency, target unit/currency, supplied conversion factors, instruction.

constraints: unit code from the canonical list

C15.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic conversion program over the supplied factors.
correct_witnesses: 1200 JPY -> 8.0 USD at supplied 150 JPY/USD
valid_alternatives: Declared rounding tolerance per case; else exact.
boundary_cases: unit only implied by context (inference required, case declares the valid implication)
currency with same symbol different code
temperature-style affine conversion

C16.cognitive_definition: Read a structured tool output (JSON/JSONL) and answer questions grounded strictly in it, ignoring stale context claims.
C16.required_observable_behavior: Answers derived only from the supplied tool result; conflicts resolved in favor of the fresh result when the case instructs so.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Comprehension of given output; no tool execution, no decision to call tools.

C16.public_task_information: Tool result document, question, (optionally) prior context marked stale, instruction.

output_contract.representation: short grounded answer or typed field
constraints: value present in the result document (extractive or derived deterministically)

C16.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic query over the result document computes the answer.
correct_witnesses: status field 'SHIPPED' -> question 'has it shipped?' answered yes per document
conflicting old note says PENDING -> fresh document wins
incorrect_witnesses: answer copied from stale prior context
valid_alternatives: Surface-form variants of the extractive answer (case declares canonicalization).
boundary_cases: empty result document (correct answer: no information)
nested field three levels deep
result contradicts common sense (must follow document)

C17.cognitive_definition: Given a typed world state (entities, values, stage), report the state predicates that hold, exactly.
C17.required_observable_behavior: Emit the set of queried state predicates true in the given state (no execution side effects).

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Read-only interpretation; state transitions belong to planning/execution families.

C17.public_task_information: Typed state document, queried predicates with formal semantics, instruction.

constraints: no predicate invented beyond the queried set

C17.independent_ground_truth: Predicate semantics implemented as a deterministic state evaluator (reference oracle).
correct_witnesses: order.stage==FULFILLED and items.all_shipped -> both reported true
stock 0 with open demand -> out_of_stock true
incorrect_witnesses: predicate true from an outdated state snapshot
valid_alternatives: Predicate order free; declared synonym predicate labels per case.
boundary_cases: state changed by a declared transition between observations
empty entity collection semantics
predicate on computed aggregate

C18.cognitive_definition: Identify which actions depend on which, given action pre/post-conditions, without executing anything.
C18.required_observable_behavior: Emit the dependency relation (edges) among the offered actions consistent with their conditions.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Static dependency analysis; sequencing into a plan is C19.

C18.public_task_information: Action set with preconditions/effects, instruction to output dependency edges.
C18.independent_ground_truth: Dependency graph computed from conditions by the reference planner library (deterministic).
correct_witnesses: create->pay->ship chain edges emitted
independent parallel actions not spuriously ordered
valid_alternatives: Edge-set equality up to declared transitive-reduction policy.
boundary_cases: mutually exclusive actions (no edge, exclusivity declared)
dependency through a shared resource
three-level chain with middle action skippable by declared shortcut
additional_eae_dependencies: EA13 planning-scope qualification of the reference planner

C19.cognitive_definition: Produce a valid action sequence (1–6 steps) achieving a goal under declared preconditions with deterministic tool outcomes.
C19.required_observable_behavior: Emit an ordered plan whose simulated execution reaches the goal state; invalid plans score as failures.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Tool outcomes are deterministic and supplied; this is plan generation, not autonomous execution success. Plan validity and execution success are scored separately.

C19.public_task_information: Initial state, goal, action set with preconditions/effects (deterministic), plan output format.

constraints: no unnecessary repeated action (declared minimality not required unless case says so)

C19.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic simulator executes the emitted plan; goal predicate evaluated after execution (validity), recorded separately from generation success.
correct_witnesses: lookup -> update -> confirm three-step plan reaching goal
one-step plan where one step suffices
incorrect_witnesses: step executed before its precondition holds
goal not reached after final step
valid_alternatives: Any plan the simulator accepts and that reaches the goal, unless the case declares a unique expected plan.
boundary_cases: goal already satisfied (empty plan is correct)
dead-end branch that must be avoided
five-to-six-step depth boundary
additional_eae_dependencies: EA13 planning-scope qualification of simulator and goal predicate

C20.cognitive_definition: Choose between action branches whose applicability depends on declared state conditions.
C20.required_observable_behavior: Select the branch (or branch sequence) whose condition matches the given state, with correct condition evaluation.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Branch selection under supplied conditions; outcome simulation deterministic and supplied.

C20.public_task_information: State, branch definitions with conditions and consequences, instruction.

output_contract.representation: branch id or guarded action list
constraints: exactly the branches whose conditions hold

C20.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic condition evaluator over the state computes the holding branch set.
correct_witnesses: risk==high branch taken when threshold exceeded
else-branch correctly taken when no explicit condition holds
valid_alternatives: Declared condition-equivalent branch ids.
boundary_cases: condition exactly at threshold
nested conditions where inner blocks outer
state making two branches applicable where policy declares precedence

C21.cognitive_definition: Given a previously valid plan and a state change that invalidates part of it, emit a corrected plan from the current state.
C21.required_observable_behavior: New plan valid from the CURRENT state (not the original one) and reaching the goal; abandoned steps must not be assumed executed.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: The state change is injected deterministically; models never execute anything. Distinguished from C19 by the requirement to abandon stale plan structure.

C21.public_task_information: Original plan, declared executed prefix, injected state change, current state, goal, action set.

output_contract.representation: ordered action list from current state
constraints: prefix-consistent (no re-execution of already-done steps unless independently required)

C21.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic simulator from current state; executed prefix fixed by the case.
correct_witnesses: payment failed mid-plan -> plan re-routes through update_payment then continues
item out of stock -> substitute action branch chosen
incorrect_witnesses: plan assumes the failed step succeeded
valid_alternatives: Any simulator-valid goal-reaching continuation consistent with the executed prefix.
boundary_cases: change that invalidates the goal itself (correct: declare unreachable when case says so)
change requiring full restart
change discovered only at a later step

C22.cognitive_definition: Recognize that a tool response or state report is an error, classify its declared error type, and distinguish it from valid data.
C22.required_observable_behavior: Emit error=true/false with the declared error code when true; valid-looking failures must not pass as data.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Recognition only; the recovery action is C23/C24. Exception masking (N02R historical defect) is the canonical failure here — evaluator and model failures stay separated.

C22.public_task_information: Tool response or state report (possibly error), declared error-code catalog, instruction.

output_contract.representation: is_error boolean + error_code + one-line evidence field

C22.independent_ground_truth: Responses constructed as errors/non-errors by design; oracle keys on the declared envelope (never on HTTP success alone).
correct_witnesses: 200-status body containing error envelope -> is_error true with code
4xx with valid error body -> code extracted, not crashed
incorrect_witnesses: error body treated as valid data (exception-masking shape)
valid_alternatives: Case-declared code aliases.
boundary_cases: error envelope nested inside a success wrapper
empty body
error code near-identical to another (transposed digits)

C23.cognitive_definition: Given a failed call with a diagnosed argument error, produce the corrected argument set for retry.
C23.required_observable_behavior: Emit arguments that pass the declared argument schema and address the diagnosed error exactly.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: The error diagnosis is supplied; producing the fix is the measured capability. Tool identity supplied (never scored as tool selection).

C23.public_task_information: Failed call record, error diagnosis, argument schema, relevant facts, instruction.

constraints: minimal change beyond the diagnosed fault unless facts require

C23.independent_ground_truth: Expected corrected arguments authored at design time; oracle validates schema + semantic diff against the diagnosed fault.
correct_witnesses: wrong date format diagnosed -> ISO-normalized retry
unknown entity diagnosed -> canonical id substitution from facts
valid_alternatives: Declared-equivalent normalizations of unaffected fields.
boundary_cases: two faults in one call (both must be fixed)
fault requiring information lookup before fix
schema change between attempts (declared)

C24.cognitive_definition: When the primary action is unavailable, select a declared alternative route that still achieves the sub-goal.
C24.required_observable_behavior: Emit an alternative action (with arguments) from the declared fallback set that achieves the sub-goal.

capability_isolation.label: diagnostic_isolation
capability_isolation.note: Fallback catalog supplied; measured capability is choosing and parameterizing the right fallback, not inventing one (invention is out of contract by design).

C24.public_task_information: Primary action and its failure, declared fallback options with conditions, current facts, instruction.
C24.independent_ground_truth: Fallback conditions encoded deterministically; simulator verifies sub-goal achievement.
correct_witnesses: direct API unavailable -> queued export fallback chosen with correct args
email bounce -> portal-notification fallback
incorrect_witnesses: fallback with primary's unmodified inappropriate arguments
valid_alternatives: Multiple declared fallbacks satisfying conditions: any accepted when case declares them equivalent; else the precedence order is authored.
boundary_cases: all fallbacks unavailable (correct: declare dead end when case says so)
fallback requiring merged arguments from two sources
fallback that only partially achieves (case declares required sub-goal scope)

C25.cognitive_definition: Decide, from explicit task-state information, whether the goal is met (stop) or work remains (continue).
C25.required_observable_behavior: Emit STOP or CONTINUE matching the goal predicate evaluated on the supplied state.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Termination judgment on given state; premature termination and unnecessary continuation are the two priced errors.

C25.public_task_information: Goal, current state (typed), action history, instruction with allowed outputs.

output_contract.representation: single token STOP or CONTINUE (+ optional reason field)
constraints: decision consistent with goal predicate on given state

C25.independent_ground_truth: Deterministic goal predicate over the state decides the label.
correct_witnesses: all items confirmed -> STOP
one item pending -> CONTINUE
valid_alternatives: None beyond the two tokens; reason field free-form and unscored.
boundary_cases: goal partially met with declared partial-accept policy
state where the only remaining action is impossible (declared: STOP as unreachable)
history suggesting momentum but state says done

C26.cognitive_definition: Decide whether the information available is sufficient to act or a clarifying question is required, and identify the missing slot when asking.
C26.required_observable_behavior: Emit ACT (with the record) or ASK (with the specific missing slot(s)); correctness requires matching the case's declared sufficiency.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Sufficiency judgment on given information; question phrasing quality is not scored (missing-slot identity is).

C26.public_task_information: Task request, available information record, required-information schema, instruction.

output_contract.representation: decision + missing slot names when ASK
constraints: when ASK, slots must be genuinely required-and-missing

C26.independent_ground_truth: Sufficiency computed against the required-information schema deterministically.
correct_witnesses: date missing for booking -> ASK date
all required fields present -> ACT
valid_alternatives: When multiple required fields are missing, any complete subset naming is accepted per case declaration; else exact set.
boundary_cases: field present but invalid format (declared: counts as missing)
optional field absent (must NOT trigger ASK)
sufficiency achievable only by inference from another field

C27.cognitive_definition: Recognize situations exceeding declared authority/competence thresholds and escalate instead of acting.
C27.required_observable_behavior: Emit ESCALATE or PROCEED per the declared threshold rules, with the triggered rule cited.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Policy thresholds supplied; judgment is threshold application, not policy authoring.

constraints: rule id from the policy when escalating

C27.independent_ground_truth: Policy encoded as deterministic predicate set; oracle evaluates.
correct_witnesses: refund above limit -> ESCALATE rule refund_limit
amount under limit, standard case -> PROCEED
valid_alternatives: When several rules trigger, case declares required set or any-one policy.
boundary_cases: value exactly at threshold (semantics preregistered)
two rules, one requires act, one escalate (precedence declared)
escalation path itself unavailable (declared fallback: still ESCALATE flag)

C28.cognitive_definition: Answer the target question correctly while irrelevant or misleading context accumulates around the relevant information.
C28.required_observable_behavior: Answer unaffected by distractor volume/similarity; the answer must come from the relevant span, never silently truncated.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Required task information is always fully present (never truncated by design); only interference varies.

C28.public_task_information: Long context containing the relevant span plus graded distractors, question, instruction.

constraints: correct value from the relevant span

C28.independent_ground_truth: Relevant span annotated; deterministic extraction of the answer from it.
correct_witnesses: policy number stated once among 40 irrelevant notes -> exact number
conflicting stale note present -> fresh declared-current span wins
valid_alternatives: Declared canonicalizations of the extractive answer.
boundary_cases: distractor near-identical to target (one digit differs)
relevant span at extreme start/end of context
conflicting observations with declared recency rule

C29.cognitive_definition: Detect genuinely ambiguous instructions and handle declared-resolvable ambiguity correctly, without inventing an interpretation for the genuinely ambiguous.
C29.required_observable_behavior: For declared-ambiguous cases: report ambiguity (flag or clarifying decision per contract). For declared-resolvable cases: apply the resolution rule.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Ambiguity labels authored by design; the resolvability rule is supplied where it exists.

C29.public_task_information: Instruction, context, (where applicable) declared resolution convention, instruction on ambiguity handling.

output_contract.representation: answer or AMBIGUOUS flag (+ conflicting readings listed)
constraints: resolvable cases must be answered, not flagged

C29.independent_ground_truth: Ambiguity classification authored per case (genuine vs resolvable-by-rule); oracle matches class + answer.
correct_witnesses: 'book the large room' with two large rooms, no rule -> AMBIGUOUS
'the large room' with declared uniqueness rule -> answered
incorrect_witnesses: arbitrary reading silently chosen for genuine ambiguity
valid_alternatives: None for the flag; listed readings free-form.
boundary_cases: ambiguity resolvable only via declared domain default
syntactic ambiguity vs referential ambiguity
ambiguity in a constraint rather than the action

C30.cognitive_definition: Produce semantically equivalent (not merely superficially similar) outputs for CN and EN versions of the same task instance.
C30.required_observable_behavior: Both language variants pass the same semantic oracle; verdicts must agree across languages for the same underlying instance.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Same instance, two language surfaces; measures language-induced semantic drift, not translation quality.

C30.public_task_information: Paired CN/EN instances (same facts, same contract), per-language instruction to answer in the given language.

output_contract.representation: language-appropriate answer matching the shared semantic contract
constraints: canonical values (ids, numbers, dates) identical across variants
response language matches the instance language

C30.independent_ground_truth: Shared semantic oracle language-neutral (canonical ids/numbers); language surface checked separately.
correct_witnesses: EN 'cancel order 881' and CN '取消订单881' both -> action cancel, id 881
date emitted as canonical ISO in both
incorrect_witnesses: EN correct, CN acts on order 818 (digit drift)
canonical value format diverges between variants
valid_alternatives: Language-specific surface forms of the same canonical value where the contract declares them.
boundary_cases: entity names untranslatable (canonical ids required)
numeral formatting conventions (full-width vs half-width)
ambiguous word in one language only (shared disambiguation rule)

C31.cognitive_definition: Generate a user-facing answer whose every claim is supported by the supplied evidence, with citations to the supporting items.
C31.required_observable_behavior: Answer with per-claim citations into the evidence set; unsupported claims fail the oracle.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Generation grounded in given evidence; no external knowledge permitted by contract.

C31.public_task_information: Evidence set (documents/records), question, citation format, instruction.

constraints: each factual claim maps to >=1 evidence id

C31.independent_ground_truth: Claim-evidence support encoded per case; oracle checks citations exist and cover the answer's required claims (required-claim set authored).
correct_witnesses: policy answer citing doc 3 for the 30-day rule
'no information' answer with zero citations where evidence lacks the fact
incorrect_witnesses: citation to an id not in the evidence set
valid_alternatives: Surface wording free; citation set must be a superset of the required minimum and subset of existing ids.
boundary_cases: evidence partially conflicting (must reflect the declared-current item)
answer requiring two evidence items combined
evidence present but irrelevant (correct: no-information answer)

C32.cognitive_definition: Calibrated self-knowledge: answer when the evidence suffices, abstain (declared marker) when it does not, and avoid confident wrong answers.
C32.required_observable_behavior: Emit the answer or the declared ABSTAIN marker according to the case's declared sufficiency; confident wrong answers are the priced failure.

capability_isolation.label: isolated_capability
capability_isolation.note: Sufficiency is declared per case; this measures the model's disposition to guess versus abstain, scored as conditional correctness and abstention calibration (never aggregated into a single accuracy).

C32.public_task_information: Question, evidence of declared (in)sufficiency, allowed outputs including the ABSTAIN marker.

output_contract.representation: answer or ABSTAIN (+ optional basis field)
constraints: ABSTAIN exactly when used per marker token

C32.independent_ground_truth: Sufficiency class authored per case; oracle expects answer-when-sufficient, ABSTAIN-when-not.
correct_witnesses: evidence lacking the fact -> ABSTAIN
evidence sufficient -> correct answer
incorrect_witnesses: confident wrong guess on insufficient evidence
valid_alternatives: Declared ABSTAIN token synonyms only.
boundary_cases: borderline sufficiency (declared class authoritative)
sufficient for partial answer only (case declares expected behavior)
ABSTAIN cost asymmetry declared per case
